title: Midnight Norwegian Kabanos Tagine
description: A hearty Norwegian dish inspired by the flavors of the night, combining the smokiness of kabanos with the warmth of a tagine.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add sliced onion and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add sliced carrots and potatoes, cook for 5 minutes.
Add cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add kabanos slices on top, folding them into the vegetable mixture.
Cover and cook for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
